title: Researchers identify six habits that make AI writing hard to read
teaser: People who use ChatGPT, Claude and other language models often find that an answer can be factually sound and still hard to read. Researchers tested that impression across 120 everyday conversations, 45 coding sessions and 980 argumentative essays, comparing model output with film subtitles, StackExchange posts and student essays. They identified six recurring habits that make AI prose feel unlike human writing—and found evidence that targeted fine-tuning can make it easier to read.
